text: The purpose of this report is to present to the Toronto Realty Agency board the outcomes of the first phase of the branding program for the new agency, including the brand strategy and brand framework as well as the proposed new name for the agency. Based on the comprehensive consultation with key internal and external stakeholders, as well as workshops and meetings with the brand working group and senior project team members, the proposed new name recommended for the Toronto Realty Agency is included in Confidential Attachment 1.

The Toronto Realty Agency: 1. Approved the new name for the Agency as set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 12, 2018) from the Transition Lead, Toronto Realty Agency. 2. Directed that the information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 12, 2018) from the Transition Lead, Toronto Realty Agency be made public at the discretion of the Toronto Realty Agency Board Chair, in consultation with the Transition Lead. (February 1, 2018): The information in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (January 12, 2018) from the Transition Lead, Toronto Realty Agency is now public. The new name for the Agency is CreateTO.
